title: [4.5] WorldEnvironment background color is ignored on MacOS Metal
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.5.dev3 and custom build (19bb18716e), MacOS 15.4.1 (MacBook Pro M2 Pro). - Not reproducible in 4.4.1, MacOS 15.4.1 (MacBook Pro M2 Pro). ### System information MacOS 15.4.1 - Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build.19bb18716 - Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) ### Issue description In Godot 4.5 dev builds on MacOS + Metal renderer, WorldEnvironment background color is ignored when running the game (in editor, I haven't tried exports). The background color is respected when using Vulkan or Godot 4.4. Find attached a MRP consisting of a WorldEnvironment using a custom color as background + Camera3D: * [background-color-mrp-metal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20138755/background-color-mrp-metal.zip) * [background-color-mrp-vulkan.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20138756/background-color-mrp-vulkan.zip) When running the project using Metal as the renderer, the background color is ignored: When running the project using Vulkan as the renderer, the background color is honored: Interestingly, I've observed entering MacOS's Mission Control results in the Godot "miniature" rendering the correct background color (which is lost again when leaving Mission Control): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9698432-8086-4866-8a0c-cd8823e84bdb While screenshots are using embedded game windows, using floating game windows results in the same behavior. ### Steps to reproduce Create a WorldEnvironment in a 3D scene using a custom color as background color, when running the project on MacOS + Metal the background color will be ignored. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) * [background-color-mrp-metal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20138755/background-color-mrp-metal.zip) * [background-color-mrp-vulkan.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20138756/background-color-mrp-vulkan.zip)
